topic: Bilingual dialogue, phone calls and supplier menus

resolution.timing: exactly once per new native dialogue graph; queued visits resolve at dialogue opening
resolution.fallback: zh* uses Chinese; other locale codes use English; missing side uses the provided side; absent Localized field preserves literal except recognized built-in defaults
resolution.defaults: original Chinese default button/failure values follow game locale; use explicit LocalizedItemText(same,same) to preserve an intentional literal equal to a built-in default
resolution.dynamicReplies: use LocalizedItemText.ForLocale(context.LocaleCode) or catalog.Resolve(context.LocaleCode,key,fallback,args); no automatic translation of author prose
resolution.csv: no owning content-pack catalog; inline only. Resolve a catalog explicitly in callbacks or create a fresh script at display time
resolution.reopen: opening the original retained script observes the new locale; active graph keeps its opening locale; supplier Continue opens a fresh graph

boundaries: IDs, requests, business callbacks and confirmation consumption do not change with locale
Phone contact names remain DisplayName callbacks; resolve on refresh/open using GameLanguage
Supplier Capture uses current capture locale; Purchase uses graph locale; no implicit payment, delivery or save
No JSON dialogue importer; these are DLL record init properties

evidence.nativeScope: 415 en/zh checks include existing and disk-loaded items, tooltips, reopened container/machine titles, reading, workshop, dialogue, phone and fixture-dispatched supplier pages. See report boundaries. Supplier fixture does not test natural arrival/payment/delivery.
